info.title: Buddy360 API
info.description: Backend API for the Buddy360 parenting-companion app. Provides authentication, child-profile management, LLM-powered guidance, and audio transcription.

post.description: Create a new user account. Sets access and refresh token cookies on success.
Authenticate with email and password. Sets access and refresh token cookies on success.
Exchange a valid refresh token cookie for a new access/refresh token pair.
Revoke the current session and clear auth cookies.
Sign in or register using a Google ID token. Creates the account on first use.

get.description: Return the authenticated user's profile (id, email, full name, role).

delete.description: Permanently delete the authenticated user's account and all associated data.

get.description: List allowed emails with pagination. Admin only.

post.description: Add an email to the allowlist. Admin only.

get.description: Fetch a single allowed email record. Admin only.

delete.description: Remove an email from the allowlist. Admin only.

get.description: List registered users with pagination. Admin only.
Look up a registered user by email address. Admin only.

patch.description: Lock a user account — revokes all tokens and blocks login. Admin only.
Unlock a previously locked user account. Admin only.

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's app preferences.

patch.description: Update one or more of the authenticated user's app preferences.

get.description: List completed growth areas for a given child, with pagination. Returns an empty list if the child does not exist (query is scoped by user_id so no data leaks).

post.description: Upsert a growth area document for a given child.

delete.description: Clear all completed growth areas for a given child.

get.description: Retrieve the parent concern for a given child. Returns an empty document if the child does not exist (query is scoped by user_id so no data leaks).

patch.description: Update the parent concern for a given child.

get.description: Retrieve all month plan documents for a given child. Returns an empty list if the child does not exist (query is scoped by user_id so no data leaks).

patch.description: Replace all month plan documents for a given child in one operation.
Upsert a single month plan document for a given child.

get.description: Retrieve the insights document for a given child. Returns an empty document if the child does not exist (query is scoped by user_id so no data leaks).

patch.description: Update the insights document for a given child.

get.description: Retrieve the observations document for a given child. Returns an empty document if the child does not exist (query is scoped by user_id so no data leaks).

patch.description: Update the observations document for a given child.

get.description: List all children linked to the authenticated user's account.

schema.title: Response List Children Api V1 Children Get

post.description: Add a new child profile to the authenticated user's account (maximum 10).

get.description: Retrieve a single child profile by ID.

patch.description: Update details of an existing child profile.

delete.description: Soft-delete a child profile. The profile is hidden immediately but retained for 30 days so accidental deletions can be recovered. Associated data (goals, growth areas, etc.) is preserved during the retention window and purged by a scheduled hard-delete job after expiry.

post.description: Mark a Personality Journey progression flag as done. One-way (false→true), one flag per call, gated on the previous step in the chain already being true — this is the only way to set these flags; PATCH /children/{child_id} silently ignores them.
Generate a presigned S3 PUT URL for uploading a child avatar photo. The client uploads directly to S3 using this URL, then PATCHes the child with the returned avatar_url.
Enqueue an LLM job. Returns a job_id immediately — the worker processes the job asynchronously. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id} for completion.

get.description: Poll the status of a previously enqueued job. Re-fetch domain data when status == 'completed'.

post.description: Send a prompt to the configured LLM provider and return the structured response.

get.description: Return which providers have a key configured and which would be auto-selected.

post.description: Transcribe an uploaded audio file to text using speech-to-text.

get.summary: Get a pre-signed S3 URL to download the latest Android APK
get.description: Returns a time-limited pre-signed S3 URL for the most recent Android APK build. The URL is valid for 5 minutes. Requires an authenticated session.
Liveness probe — returns 200 OK when the process is running.
Health check with build metadata (git SHA, branch, commit timestamp, tag).
